hint: tap anywhere to welcome him home

game.q: his father spots him far down the road. what does he do?
opts: waits at the door, arms crossed

wrong.arms: that’s the lecture version. not this dad.

game.right: YES. he runs. a grown man running in public was undignified back then. he didn’t care.

end.line: a son blew everything and came home with a speech. his dad ran, and never let him finish.
end.l1: he came home with a speech.
end.l2: his dad ran before he finished.

cliff.s2: caught nothing. then someone asks him to try once more.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: nets out one more time.

share: he took the money. he blew it all. then he came home, and dad ran. a story Jesus told, on infinite hill
